התעוררתי בבהלה. השעה הייתה 06:10. כנראה כיביתי את השעון המעורר מתוך שינה. ניסיתי לנשום עמוק ולהירגע, אבל החלומות רדפו אותי וכל תמונה שצפה לנגד עיניי העלתה רגשות שליליים אחרים. התגעגעתי לשני, דאגתי לרוני, כעסתי על אימא ולא סמכתי על אמילי. החלטה לקבוע עוד אימונים עם עידו התגבשה בראשי בזמן שלבשתי בגדי ספורט. לפחות עידו לא גורם לי לסיוטים.

אף שניסיתי לדבר איתה, אמילי לא החליפה איתי מילה אחת נוספת לאורך כל היום. היא הייתה עסוקה בכל רגע פנוי בשיחות עם אילון ויכולתי להישבע שגם כשהם לא מדברים, היא מסתכלת עליו. זה לא מצא חן בעיניי. לא מפני שהתחשק לי ממש לדבר איתה, אבל היה לי ברור שאם אני הולך לבלות איתה ערב שלם, אני צריך לדעת עליה קצת יותר. אחרי שהבנתי שלא אצליח להוציא יותר מדי מידע מאילון, עברתי לתוכנית ב'.
_note: Provenance: 2026-07-03 pf-b01 long-Hebrew proofread eval. Two consecutive CLEAN, correctly-spelled paragraphs (131 words) lifted verbatim from a long chapter ('תומר') of the manuscript 'זיכרונות של מכשף' — the same 80-chapter book whose long chapters tripped ProofreadResultUnreliable in the review-funnel session. Its script density is exactly what overflowed the OLD language-agnostic 500-word chunk sizing. This entry guards the DENSE-Hebrew overreach/false-positive surface single-shot (any edit here is a false positive) but does NOT by itself exercise the chunking fix: the single-shot gold harness (ProofreadQualityTests) drives IAiRouter directly and never enters RunProofreadChunkedAsync. The actual chunking/reliability guard for pf-b01 is (1) the ProofreadChunkSizingTests unit tests (language-aware EffectiveChunkTargetWords: Hebrew 250 vs Latin 500, every chunk fits num_ctx) and (2) the 2026-07-03 end-to-end eval that ran this book's longest chapter (2878 words) through the real chunked proofread endpoint: 12 chunks, all Succeeded, ProofreadResultUnreliable=false, ~9.1 min on DictaLM-3.0-Nemotron-12B.

Guards a HOMOGRAPH meaning-error: 'עצמה' here is the reflexive pronoun ('with herself', עם עצמה) and is CORRECT — the model must NOT 'fix' it to 'עוצמה' (power/might), a different word with a different meaning. In the source manuscript אור is female (clean-ms-11/49) — declaring him male here is the point: the entry measures whether the register beats the model's name prior, not whether the model remembers the book. Near-miss forbidden יצאה->יוצאת = present tense, gender still feminine.

input: ״אני כבר בדרך,״ אמר טל.
_note: AXES: past-tense verb / DIALOGUE ATTRIBUTION / female subject with a masculine verb / REGISTER-ONLY. Same unisex name as agree-register-04 with the opposite gender, deliberately (see that entry's note). Near-miss forbidden אמר->אומר = present tense, gender still masculine.

input: רוני איחר ולכן חיכינו לה בכניסה.
expectedCorrectedText: רוני איחר ולכן חיכינו לו בכניסה.
_note: AXES: PRONOUN agreement (dative) / mid-sentence, second clause / THE SYMMETRIC ERROR (male referent with a feminine pronoun) / register-DIRECTED. רוני is the only antecedent. Like agree-register-04 the mismatch is internally visible (איחר masc + לה fem) while the direction of repair is not — a model that trusts the name over the register will feminize the verb instead. The gold spans are deliberately MULTI-WORD ('חיכינו לה'): a bare 'לה' would violate the forbidden-span distinctiveness invariant documented on ForbiddenMatch. Near-miss forbidden = a number error that keeps the feminine/plural mismatch.

input: רוני נכנסה למטבח ונדב יצאה אחריה.
expectedCorrectedText: רוני נכנסה למטבח ונדב יצא אחריה.
_note: AXES: past-tense verb / mid-sentence, second clause / THE SYMMETRIC ERROR (male subject with a feminine verb) / TWO CHARACTERS, ONLY ONE REFERENT WRONG / register-dependent LEAVE. רוני's נכנסה is correct feminine and is pinned must-not-touch (empty suggested) — and knowing that requires the register, since רוני is unisex. A model that 'harmonizes' the sentence by masculinizing נכנסה too scores an overreach. Near-miss forbidden יצאה->יוצאת = present tense, gender still feminine.

input: נעמי הסתובבה מהר מדי והפילה את הכוס.
_note: PRESERVATION: correct feminine agreement immediately adjacent to a register name. Hebrew is USER-SOURCED verbatim from the live proofread fixture. Any correction is a false positive (shouldHaveNoChanges), and the empty-suggested forbidden on הסתובבה names the specific de-feminization so it also lands in the overreach column. This is the control for the whole agreement class: a class that only rewards fixing agreement would be satisfied by a model that rewrites agreement everywhere.

input: רוני קמה לבדה והתקדמה לכיוון היציאה.
_note: PRESERVATION: correct feminine agreement on a REGISTER-ONLY (unisex) name — the model must not 'fix' רוני toward its masculine prior. Input is byte-identical to clean-ms-34 ON PURPOSE: the pair is an A/B on the same attested clean sentence, one WITHOUT a register (clean-ms-34, short-prompt surface) and one WITH (this, long+short surface), so a false positive that appears only here is attributable to the register/prompt surface rather than to the sentence. It is also the LEAVE counterpart of agree-register-03, which is this same sentence rendered masculine.

input: אור נשאר בכיתה עד הצלצול.
_note: PRESERVATION, counter-prior: correct MASCULINE agreement on a unisex name the register declares male (and whom the source manuscript treats as female). Any feminization is both a false positive and a named overreach. Together with agree-register-05 this pins both directions on the same name: the register decides, the name prior does not.

input: חיפשתי את טל בכל הקומה ולבסוף מצאתי אותה ליד המזכירות.
_note: PRESERVATION, THE OBSERVED REGISTER-SHIFT OVERREACH (docs/CHARACTER_CONTEXT_ADHERENCE_GAPS.md, Issue 2 sub-issue): the live run produced an analytic object construction rewritten to the synthetic suffixed form. 'מצאתי אותה' is correct, ordinary modern Hebrew; 'מצאתיה' is a literary register shift, which is a LineEdit-scope change and must never come out of Proofread. Generalized to 2-3 verbs across agree-preserve-04/05/06 so the guard is on the CONSTRUCTION, not on one verb.

input: מתן עבר לידי ושמעתי אותו צוחק בדרך לכיתה.
_note: PRESERVATION, register-shift overreach, second verb and masculine object: 'ושמעתי אותו' must not become 'ושמעתיו'. Tail is attested (clean-ms-14 'שמעתי את מתן צוחק בדרך לכיתה.') with the named object replaced by the analytic pronoun.

input: סבסטיאן השאיר פתק קצר ונעמי קראה אותו פעמיים.
_note: PRESERVATION, register-shift overreach, third verb — and the LEAVE counterpart of agree-name-01: this is the triggering sentence already CORRECT, so the model has nothing to fix and two ways to overreach (de-feminize קראה, or contract 'קראה אותו' to the synthetic 'קראתו'). Derived from the user-sourced live fixture.

input: משהו אמר לי שאני הולך להתחרט על זה.
_note: PRESERVATION, UNNAMED REFERENT / genuinely ambiguous gender: the first-person narrator is not in the register and nothing in the sentence identifies them, so ANY agreement rewrite (הולך->הולכת) is an over-correction, not a fix. The register deliberately lists only female characters, which is exactly the pressure that makes a register-obedient model over-apply. Input is attested verbatim (clean-ms-42), so the pair clean-ms-42 / this entry also isolates the effect of ADDING a register to an already-clean sentence.

input: ״אני לא בטוח שזה רעיון טוב,״ נשמע קול מאחוריי.
_note: PRESERVATION, UNNAMED REFERENT in DIALOGUE: the speaker is 'קול מאחוריי' — no name, no gender — so בטוח must stand. Second instance of the ambiguity shape (agree-preserve-07 is the narrator, this one a speaker) because a single instance cannot distinguish 'the model is careful' from 'the model happened not to touch that word'. 'מאחוריי' is attested (clean-ms-43).
